notes: The Pearl Lots by day, the dugout's beach and its jetty: the grading-ground canoe (boat.pearl-lots.grading-ground-canoe) lies on the shore at (5433.1, 4294.2), the lot beach (socket.pearl-lots.lot-beach, kind beach) 45 m west along the shore and the lot jetty (socket.pearl-lots.lot-jetty, kind landing) 8 m east of the canoe. Lead-in: board from the shore south of the hull and cast off. Filmed: the paddle along the shore to the beach (driveTo on the headless paddleTo route over the same water), E runs the canoe up and ties it on the beach, E casts off again, the paddle back to the jetty with the jetty ahead of the bow in shot, E moors at it. Who is near: n2 (the canoe's keeper) at 5 m by her grading ground, the n1 crew 20 m off at the drying racks; no watch and no hostile within sight. Lit: the sky at 10:00 (103811 lx). What wins E: the hull (its beam/2 + 2 m reach, 2.9 m from the shore spot); n2 stands past a person's 2.5 m reach. Staged: the canoe is the player's (stage.owns; it is n2's in boats.json and taking it in front of her is a witnessed theft): the scene tests beaching and mooring, not ownership.
